_comment: MOS-UI-208: the window/level preset table. A NAMED CONFIGURATION FILE, versioned with
the deployment, not hard-coded. Each entry carries a name, width and centre in HU, a key
binding, and THE SOURCE OF THE VALUES.
MOS-REL-077 forbids inventing a value that has no source in the specification or a
registry, and MOS-UI-208 says so of window presets specifically: 'the correct source is
the department's incumbent viewer configuration or the reading convention the physician
already uses, captured once and recorded, not a number chosen here.'
THAT CAPTURE HAS NOT HAPPENED. Every row below is marked source: 'convention_unverified'
and is a widely published convention, NOT this department's configuration. They are here
so the surface is usable, and they are marked so that nobody mistakes them for the
captured set. Replacing them is a five-minute conversation with the physician who asked
for RadiAnt ergonomics, and until it happens MOS-UI-208 is UNMET, not satisfied.
MOS-UI-214 requires that status to be recorded in the MOS-UI-202 register row with its

UNITS ARE NOW DATA. Every entry with a centre carries "unit": "HU", because that is what these conventions are defined in, and the surface refuses to apply one to a series whose values are not in that unit -- measured: the Brain window (W 80 L 40) applied to brain MR, whose values are arbitrary signal intensity, whites the panel out entirely. The "Default" entry carries no unit: it is the acquisition's own (0028,1050/1051) and is valid on any modality.

presets.name: Default
presets.note: (0028,1050) WindowCenter and (0028,1051) WindowWidth from the series header. The only entry here with an authoritative source: it is what the acquisition itself declared.

presets.name: Lung
presets.note: Published thoracic convention. MOS-UI-208 names lung as a minimum for a thoracic campaign. Not captured from the department.

presets.name: Soft tissue
presets.note: Published convention. Not captured from the department.

presets.name: Bone
presets.note: Published convention. Not captured from the department.

presets.name: Brain
presets.note: Published convention. Out of scope for a thoracic campaign; present because the archive is not restricted to thorax.

presets.name: Mediastinum
presets.note: Published convention. MOS-UI-208 names mediastinum as a minimum for a thoracic campaign alongside lung. Not captured from the department.
